parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of an electric fan, made of lightweight plastic for efficient air movement.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, driven by an electric motor located at the center hub.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the electric fan, typically made of metal to provide stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan assembly and houses the motor and electrical components, ensuring balance and safety.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the structural foundation for the rotating fan blades.
